bio_en: Haji Murad Khachatrian, code-named Haykak, was born in 1865 in Nor Gyugh in the Gavash district of Vaspurakan and studied at the school of the historic Narek monastery. He grew up amid the awakening inspired by Khrimian Hayrik at Varag; in 1889 he went to Jerusalem chiefly to see the exiled Khrimian, meeting there the political exile Markos Natanian and the Hnchak Hakob Meghavorian. A loyal ARF member from youth, he served the party in Vaspurakan, in the Ararat region and in Iran. He died in Tehran on 8 September 1949, aged 84.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: medium. Not to be confused with Haykak Kosoyan. Text truncated.
